item.title: Aspirus St. Luke’s in Duluth becomes first hospital to earn NICU designation
item.description: DULUTH, Minn.– Aspirus St Lukes in Duluth is the first hospital in the country to be designated for their level 2 NICU. The designation shows that they’ve met guidelines for proper equipment, protocols, and staff training. item.title: Duluth Marshall Girls Hoops Hands Rock Ridge 1st Loss
item.description: DULUTH, Minn.- The Duluth Marshall girls basketball team earned a statement win on Tuesday night. Playing unbeaten Rock Ridge, the Hilltoppers held on for the 80-72 win. Duluth Marshall (2-1) will next host Duluth Denfeld on Thursday. As for Rock Ridge (3-1), they are at Cloquet on Friday. Categories: High School, Sports
